_doc: doc 05 §3: 3 units x 5 cards, given grouped by unit in priority order (A1..A5, B1..B5, C1..C5). Step 1: remaining A5 B5 C5, no previous -> tie on count, first-seen A (index 0) -> A1. Step 2: A excluded, B5 = C5 -> B (first seen 5 < 10) -> B1. Step 3: A4 vs C5 (B excluded) -> C1. Step 4: A4 = B4 (C excluded) -> A2. The same pattern repeats, giving A B C cycles: A1 B1 C1 A2 B2 C2 ... A5 B5 C5. 0 adjacency violations; no questions, no confusables.
